knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The sample teaches theory first, then demonstration and watched practice, then supervised work and evaluation.
A task is not signed off until it is achieved to standard and re-checked, so repetition continues until the trainee can do it.
The evaluation records observed achievements and repeats with dates. Training alone does not prove competence or licensing.

practicalCriteria: The learner delivers a demonstration of a supplied housekeeping task, then observes a trainee attempt and records one repeat.
The learner writes a final evaluation for a trainee that lists achieved tasks, repeated tasks and dates.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
stopWorkCriteria: Stop and refer any task where the trainee is working without the supervision the plan requires.
Stop and refer any task that needs a licence the trainee does not hold.
